meta.name: convex-migration-helper
meta.description: Plans Convex schema and data migrations with widen-migrate-narrow and @convex-dev/migrations. Use for breaking schema changes, backfills, table reshaping, or zero-downtime rollouts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并执行 Convex 数据库的零停机迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 Convex 并需要安全地变更数据库 schema
copy.tagline_en: Plan and execute zero-downtime Convex database migrations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Convex and need to safely change your database schema

howto.what: Claude 会帮你规划 Convex 数据库的 schema 和数据迁移，采用“放宽-迁移-收紧”三步法，并推荐使用 @convex-dev/migrations 组件来处理批量更新、断点续传等。
howto.when: 当你需要修改已有数据的 schema（如添加必填字段、改变字段类型、拆分表等）且希望零停机时触发。

say.text: 我要给 users 表加一个必填的 nickname 字段，怎么迁移？

howto.what_en: Claude helps you plan Convex schema and data migrations using the widen-migrate-narrow pattern and recommends the @convex-dev/migrations component for batching, resuming, and dry runs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to make breaking schema changes (e.g., adding required fields, changing types, splitting tables) with zero downtime.

say_en.text: I need to add a required nickname field to the users table. How do I migrate?
say_en.note: Claude will outline the widen-migrate-narrow workflow.

say_en.text: Write a migration script to change the author field in posts from string to userId.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code using the migrations component.
